description: This file contains repository classes for database operations within a sports live streaming backend, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM with asynchronous sessions. It defines repositories for managing users, profiles, matches, events, highlights, and related database interactions.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: Base class providing common database session management.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user-related database operations.

classes.name: UserProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository class for user profile database operations.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository class for match-related database operations.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository class for event-related database operations.

classes.name: HighlightRepository
classes.description: Repository class for highlight-related database operations.

methods.name: UserDB create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] get_user_by_username(self, username: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username.

methods.name: Optional[UserDB] update_user(self, user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate)
methods.description: Updates existing user information.

methods.name: UserProfileDB create_profile(self, profile_data: UserProfileCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user profile.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_user_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches profile associated with a user ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] get_profile_by_id(self, profile_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches profile by profile ID.

methods.name: Optional[UserProfileDB] update_profile(self, profile_id: str, profile_data: UserProfileUpdate)
methods.description: Updates existing user profile information.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of matches with filtering options.

methods.name: Optional[MatchDB] get_match_by_id(self, match_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves match details by its ID, including related data.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_live_matches(self)
methods.description: Fetches all currently live matches.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_upcoming_matches(self, days: int = 7, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Fetches upcoming matches within specified days.

methods.name: List[MatchDB] get_matches_by_event_id(self, event_id: str, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves matches associated with a specific event.

methods.name: int get_total_matches_count(self, status: Optional[MatchStatus] = None)
methods.description: Counts total matches with optional status filtering.

methods.name: List[EventDB] get_events(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, sport_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of events, optionally filtered by sport type.

methods.name: Optional[EventDB] get_event_by_id(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches an event and its matches by ID.

methods.name: List[HighlightDB] get_highlights(self, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0, match_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves paginated highlights, optionally filtered by match.

methods.name: Optional[HighlightDB] get_highlight_by_id(self, highlight_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a highlight by its ID.

methods.name: __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: unavailable
